title: allow_http=true without use_emulator permits accidental plaintext in production
description: AzureBackendConfig.allow_http permits plain HTTP connections. The intended use case is Azurite local testing. However, nothing prevents an operator from setting allow_http = true against a real Azure Blob Storage endpoint. The config validator does not warn when allow_http = true but use_emulator = false. An operator who copies a development config to production could silently enable unencrypted storage traffic for article data. A warning or at minimum a prominent doc comment on the allow_http field noting the production risk would catch this.
